### Variable List



```{r test, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

      

blockMap <- blockMap %>%
  left_join(surveyInfo %>% select(Item.ID, Item.Type), by = "Item.ID")

out2 <- ""



for(blockIdx in 1:nrow(blockMap)) {
  thisBlock <- blockMap[blockIdx, ]
  
  if(thisBlock$Item.Type == "Question") {
    attach(thisBlock)
    
    # Make check for multiple slider and call a for loop to iteratively call each quesiton so that the Table of Contents is generated
    if (thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name == "Multiple Slider") {
      
      question_id = thisBlock$Question.ID
          
      # String split and unlist on current question id
      raw_data <- unlist(strsplit(thisData$User.Response[thisData$Question.ID == question_id], ","))
      
      
      # Split on colon now keeping the question identifier and user response together
      temp_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, strsplit(raw_data, split = ":")))
      
      # Convert to numeric
      temp_df$V2 <- as.numeric(temp_df$V2)
      
      # Remove missingness from data frame so that it doesn't try to group by NA values
      no_missing_df <- temp_df[complete.cases(temp_df), ]
      

      # Add a row ID to preserve position within each group
      no_missing_df <- no_missing_df %>%
        group_by(V1) %>%
        mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
        ungroup()
      
      # Pivot to wide format
      wide_df <- no_missing_df %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = V1, values_from = V2) %>%
        select(-row_id)
       
      
      # Now call for loop for each column in the dataframe we created
      for (col in 1:ncol(wide_df)) {
        
        # Grab current variable
        thisVar <- wide_df[,col]
        
        
        # Grab question text
        question_text = responseKey$definition[responseKey$question == question_id & responseKey$value == names(thisVar)]
      
        out2 <- paste0(
          out2,
          knit_expand(
            file = "DataTypes/MultipleSlider.Rmd",
            question_text = question_text
          )
        )
      }
         
    # If not multiple slider type, proceed as usual
    } else  {
      
    question_type <- thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name
    question_type_no_space <- gsub(" ", "", question_type)

    out2 <- paste(
      out2,
      knit_expand(
        file = paste0("DataTypes/", question_type_no_space, ".Rmd"),
        question_text = thisBlock$Question.Text,
        item_id = thisBlock$Item.ID,
        question_type = thisBlock$Question.Type.Display.Name,
        result_type = thisBlock$Result.Type,
        question_id = thisBlock$Question.ID
      )
    )
    }
    detach(thisBlock)
  }
}
```
